ops.text: drive on a Sprite lane (~/.local/bin/drive) blocks silently for as long as the coordinator's watch leaves its DRIVE question unanswered: drive status, drive job set --repro and drive pr add sat 26 to 80 minutes with no output and no line naming the relay id or how long it has waited, so the lane cannot tell a slow watch from a dead one or say which question to chase. It should print the relay id and a waiting line to stderr each time it resumes its 600s wait.
